root_cause: Order-flow signal at tested horizons (500ms, 2s, 10s) has in-sample statistical content but zero or negative economic value after execution costs. BTC price moves at these horizons (std 1.7-2.3 bps) are smaller than execution costs (1.6-14.5 bps). The GBR model (V15) overfits to calibration data (R2 train=0.82, test=-0.04) and fails to generalize to forward data. Even with execution-aware routing and regime filtering, predicted return magnitudes do not materialize as actual profits.
